info.title: VoidPlayer read-only media provider
info.description: Implement on the external storage adapter. The configured endpoint is the base URL. One endpoint exposes one virtual root.

get.summary: List direct children in bounded, consistent pages

parameters.name: directory
parameters.description: Root is the empty string. Nested directories use slash-separated display names.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor for this directory traversal.

200.description: At most limit distinct direct children per page. A nonterminal page contains at least one entry. Complete traversal or return an error if continuity cannot be guaranteed.

409.description: Listing changed or cursor expired. Caller retains previous unseen entries and reconciles on the next scan.

get.summary: Describe the current object without reading its content

200.description: Current source identity, byte length and modification time.

get.summary: Read one exact range, conditional on the current revision

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: Inclusive start and end, at most 1048576 bytes.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: One strong entity tag, the revision in double quotes.

206.description: Exactly the requested bytes. No content encoding. Provider checks revision as part of the read and stops upstream I/O on disconnect.

412.description: Revision does not match. No media bytes.

416.description: Invalid or unsatisfiable range. No media bytes.

Failure.description: 400 invalid parameters, 401/403 missing credentials or access denied, 404 missing object or directory, 429/503 temporarily unavailable. Never turn a storage failure into a successful empty listing.

Name.description: One display path component. Dot and dot-dot are invalid. VoidPlayer skips hidden names.

ObjectId.description: Opaque stable object lookup key scoped to the configured root.

revision.description: Stable for identical revision, changes whenever bytes change. Encode opaque upstream validators as needed.
